name: Minecraft (Java Edition)
description: GiftDeck sets up and runs a Minecraft server on this PC (PaperMC). You join it from Minecraft, and gifts summon mobs, drop TNT, change the weather, give items and effects, and more.

server.join: In Minecraft: Multiplayer > Direct Connection > localhost

requirements: Minecraft: Java Edition (bought, any launcher). The server's version must match the version you play.
Accept the Minecraft EULA before the server's first start
About 500 MB of disk space and 2 GB of memory for the server
